patthana23.35:1.1: na uppanno na kusalo dhammo uppannassa kusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo:. ārammaṇe satta.
patthana23.35:2.1: na uppanno na akusalo dhammo uppannassa akusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo:. ārammaṇe cha.
patthana23.35:4.1: na uppanno na abyākato dhammo uppannassa abyākatassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo:.
patthana23.35:6.1: atītattikaṃ uppannattikasadisaṃ. naatītārammaṇattika nakusalattike atītārammaṇattika kusalattikaṃ
